scheme_name: Advance for Purchase or Construction of House (GBOCWWB)
other_conditions: The worker must have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker in the year.
The applicant must have had continuous membership in the Fund for five years.
The applicant must have fifteen years of service for superannuation.
benefits_summary: An advance of up to ₹50,000 is sanctioned, to be recovered in equal instalments as fixed by the Board.
